title: Galia Expanse
description: Explore the contested frontier of Star Atlas, where territory, extraction, and faction pressure turn scale into meaningful stakes.
heroTitle: The frontier is only compelling when it feels contested.
heroSummary: Galia is where scale becomes pressure. It is not empty spectacle. It is a frontier shaped by faction rivalry, extraction, navigation, and the risk of being exposed in valuable territory.
utilityLine: This page has one purpose: explain why the Galia Expanse matters as the universe backbone.

heroMedia.label: Galia preview
heroMedia.caption: The universe page should communicate tension, scale, and opportunity in one frame.

heroPanel.title: Galia is the reason the rest of the system matters.
heroPanel.body: Without a meaningful frontier, ships, trade, and faction identity all feel abstract. This page now anchors those systems in a place worth competing over.
bullets: Economy tied to location and risk

sections.heading: A premium sci-fi universe needs more than pretty emptiness.
body: Galia earns attention because it combines beauty with consequence. Valuable routes, extractable resources, and faction-aligned space all create reasons to move, defend, scout, and claim.
The redesign strips away excess copy and explains the world through a smaller number of legible ideas: what the space is, why it matters, and how a player fits into it.
bullets: Travel is tied to opportunity and danger
Lore supports the conflict instead of overwhelming it
sections.asideTitle: The frontier clarifies the rest of the site architecture.
sections.asideBody: Game, economy, and faction pages now all point back to this shared spatial context.

sections.heading: What a player actually does in contested space.

cards.title: Scout and traverse
cards.body: Move through valuable zones with a constant tradeoff between visibility, speed, and safety.

cards.title: Extract under pressure
cards.body: Resource gathering feels meaningful when the terrain and the politics around it create tension.

cards.title: Defend, challenge, expand
cards.body: The frontier is where faction presence, opportunism, and escalation meet.

sections.heading: The minimum context a new visitor needs.

items.question: Is Galia lore or gameplay?
items.answer: It is both, but the page now leads with function. Lore supports player motivation instead of hiding it.

items.question: Why is this page shorter than before?
items.answer: Because first-touch pages should reduce cognitive load. The goal is immediate understanding, then optional deeper reading.

items.question: Where should someone go after this page?
items.answer: Either into the browser experience for immediate engagement or into the fleet and economy pages for a more strategic view.

finalCta.title: Move from the frontier into the systems built around it.
finalCta.text: Follow the universe into faction identity, fleet command, or the browser-first economy entry points.
